text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Tuesday chaired a cabinet meeting on the use of computers in the administration.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui said in in International meeting on foreign financing of the 9th development plan 1997-2001 that investments needs were put at 42 billion dinars.
- Abdelhafidh Harguem named chairman of the High Communication Council.
- Tunisian and French centres of telecommunications research on Tuesday signed an accord to boost cooperation.
- Parliament on Tuesday adopted a law organising "time share" formula in tourism.
- Tunisia and Sweden to boost cooperation in environment sector.
- Cereals harvest started on Tuesday in the northern Beja region.
